mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in CPIAUCSL (deflationary trend) reduces inflation expectations, lowering real interest rates and boosting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 5% in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE stays above 5% for less than a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly rises in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (monetary tightening) signal aggressive rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise > 0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the joint rise in both series does not exceed 0.2% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (supply contraction) signals weakening production capacity, prompting expectations of inflation and higher growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or INDPRO recovers without sustained contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in PAYEMS above 200,000 in a month indicates severe labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the surge in PAYEMS does not exceed 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not decline in the context of a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in INDPRO (supply contraction) and UNRATE (labor market weakening) signal dual headwinds, reducing corporate investment and consumer demand, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and UNRATE decline in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the declines in both series do not occur concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and accelerating equity inflows, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not decline in the context of an easing cycle.
